report: Biopsy of the tender enlarging scalp lesion shows a dermal malignant neoplasm with hyperchromatic nuclei, mitoses, and necrosis, refuting benign/inflammatory causes. Diffuse SMA positivity with negative epithelial, melanocytic, vascular, and STAT6 markers confirms smooth muscle sarcoma. Loss of desmin, h-caldesmon, calponin, and smooth muscle myosin specifies atypical leiomyosarcoma. Thus the frontier is sufficiently refined and the diagnosis is atypical leiomyosarcoma.
